ينتهبا (form VIII)
# يَنْتَهِبَا (yantahibā) /jan.ta.hi.baː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# يُنْتَهَبَا (yuntahabā) /jun.ta.ha.baː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
